nodes.label: coverage.py — what the corpus names against what the repo holds
nodes.rationale: Walks the two live bundles, collects every filename-shaped token, resolves each against the whole repo and writes COVERAGE.tsv: 1,005 named, 813 held, 15 via alias, 177 ABSENT.

nodes.label: ABSENT is not a finding of loss
nodes.rationale: It means not reachable from any source in this repo; a name in prose is not proof a file ever existed, and much of what the work produced was never exported from the chat that made it.

nodes.label: --chats is not optional
nodes.rationale: A plain run overwrites COVERAGE.tsv with the 177-ABSENT census and drops every IN-CHAT resolution; the committed file reproduces byte-for-byte only with the flag.

nodes.label: IN-CHAT-BODY versus IN-CHAT
nodes.rationale: A shard carrying the document's own title line evidences a recoverable body; a bare mention does not, and the weaker status is never reported as the stronger. Headings only evidence a body for Markdown.

nodes.label: HELD-VIA-ALIAS — the figure rename
nodes.rationale: FIGURE_ASSETS.md maps all 33 main-volume figures from their pre-rename source name; all 33 source images are held and fifteen renamed copies were never written.

nodes.label: Every count is a floor, not a total
nodes.rationale: Extraction is deliberately literal: the bundles name 58 handoffs in filename shape against 88 cited by bare number.

nodes.label: The four remaining ABSENT names are spellings, not documents
nodes.rationale: HANDOFF96.md, HANDOFF98.md and two uuid-prefixed forms of handoffs the repo holds hyphenated; the census is literal and does not guess at such mappings.

nodes.label: Two genuine figure gaps
nodes.rationale: The papers' 25-file f<N>_<M>.png set, in no archive, project export or manifest row; and figure-D.1-prior-32-elements.png, the kept pre-re-render copy.
